stem.text: High concentrations of ethanol can disrupt cell membrane structure and make the cell surface membrane leaky.
Yeast cells release ethanol as a waste product of metabolism.
Yeast cells can alter the composition of the cell surface membrane to reduce the effect of ethanol.

items: A saturated fatty acid, X, is replaced by an unsaturated fatty acid, Y.
Y has a shorter hydrocarbon chain than X.
There is an increase in the phospholipid to protein ratio.

stem.text: Which statement would explain why the effect of ethanol is reduced?

A.text: A greater proportion of phospholipid may increase the entry of ethanol via channel proteins.

B.text: An increase in hydrophobic interaction by phospholipid tails improves membrane stability.

C.text: An increase in the proportion of fatty acids with double bonds decreases membrane fluidity.

D.text: The shorter hydrocarbon chain of Y decreases membrane fluidity.
